content_html:
This is our company’s product: PhoText( https://photext.ai)

What it does

Edit text that is already in a photo or screenshot. Upload the image, click the line you want to change, type the new words. Recognition, background repair, and matching font / color / perspective are handled for you. No Photoshop, no layers.

JPG, PNG, JPEG, WEBP, and BMP. Typical use: posters, product shots, UI screenshots, signs.

Why this post

We just launched on Product Hunt:

https://www.producthunt.com/products/photext-2/photext-2/prelaunch

PH ranking on launch day is mostly real clicks and comments in the first few hours. If this is useful to you, an upvote or a short note about what you tried would mean a lot. If it isn’t, say what broke — I’ll be in the thread.

Try it

https://photext.ai

Got a nasty case — curved type, tiny text, messy screenshots? Drop it here.
